name: Saint Bonaventura
biography: General of the Franciscan order who forbade Bacon to publish; a follower of Anselm who upheld the ontological argument, saw Aristotelianism as fundamentally opposed to Christianity, and believed in Platonic ideas known perfectly only by God.
